Lydia Jin

I write: philosophy, code, & music

About

I dedicate my life to encouraging people to think harder, bigger, and with more care.

In June 2026, I graduated from Dartmouth College with a BA in both Philosophy and Computer Science.

The past couple of years, I've worked in big tech, honing my toolkit to build a better, kinder, and safer world.

I continue to write philosophy both casually through Substack, and academically, through publishing and presenting at international conferences.

Music

Since childhood, music has felt like a second home. From classical violin and piano, to rock bass guitar, and now to original songs, I play at open mics whenever I can.
